staking.name: Zebec SuperApp staking (zebec-stake-sdk)

text.holders.held.info: {ticker} in retail wallets compared with {ticker} in custody at known exchange wallets. All chains combined. Retail includes {stakedTotal} staked {ticker}, credited to each staker's wallet from Zebec SuperApp staking (counted once, so it isn't a separate supply bucket).
text.holders.retailHeld.info:
{ticker} held in ordinary wallets — everything except exchange custody, treasury and team wallets, and DEX liquidity.

Shown separately from CEX Balance rather than blended into one total, because the two moving in opposite directions is the signal: {ticker} leaving exchanges for self-custody is accumulation, the reverse is supply moving toward the market. A combined figure stays flat through both.

Staked {ticker} is already inside this figure (credited to each staker's wallet), not added on top.
text.holders.staked.info:
{ticker} locked in Zebec SuperApp staking: the raw sum of every unclaimed on-chain staking position (~4.75B at the 2026-10-28 scan), counted once per staker. It's a subset of Retail Held (already counted there, credited to each staker's wallet), shown separately as a measure of long-term conviction. Staked {ticker} can't be moved until the lockup pays it out.

Disclaimer — Super App "Global Staked" is not current TVL: Zebec's Super App shows a much larger "Global Staked" figure (~18.9B) that appears to sum each lockup's cumulative totalStaked counter, not live unclaimed positions. This site's Staked tile is live TVL — the sum of unclaimed UserStakeData positions (~4.75B). Open the (i) methodology tip on Staking Overview for Solscan links to the staking program, lockups, and stake vaults so you can verify both numbers on-chain.

ZBCN Lockup vault gap (2.42%): this one lockup (AYbW5cbZEUgLEj6Eiy3yg74PU3YbEHkbFxgW6fjbSJjp) is exempt from our 0.5% position-vs-vault reconcile check. Its unclaimed positions add up to ~2.42% (~4.39M {ticker}) more than its stake-vault token account (ATA) currently holds. The Staked tile publishes those raw position sums as-is. Supply credits each staker only up to what the stake vaults hold, so that gap is not invented into Retail. Two reward vaults (undistributed rewards, which are nobody's stake) stay outside Retail as their own small slice.
text.staking.intro: {ticker} staked in Zebec SuperApp staking, summed from unclaimed on-chain positions and credited to each staker. It's a subset of Retail Held (already counted there), not its own supply bucket.
text.supply.staking.description: Undistributed {ticker} still sitting in Zebec SuperApp reward vaults — nobody's stake. Staked {ticker} is credited to each staker and included in Retail, not this slice. Zebec Super App "Global Staked" (~18.9B) is a different, cumulative-looking metric and is not this balance.
text.supply.residual.title: Below the {supply} max (buybacks / burns)
text.supply.residual.body: The ~{gap} gap between the fixed {total} max supply and every {ticker} balance we count on Solana. {name} keeps a fixed {supply} max while buybacks and burns shrink the on-chain supply, so this is a reconcile note — on-chain supply sitting slightly under the max — not missing wallets and not tokens in a bridge ({ticker} here is Solana-only).
text.supply.residual.note: Counted wallets add up to the mint's current on-chain supply; the shortfall to {total} is consistent with buybacks/burns (not itemised burn-by-burn here). Recomputed on every refresh.
text.supply.holdings.description: Holdings ({amount} {ticker}). supplyBreakdown.how: Total supply is the fixed {supply} max. We split it into simple buckets — retail wallets (including staked {ticker} credited to each staker), undistributed staking rewards, exchange custody, project treasury, holdings, and a small gap below the max — so the pieces add to {supply}. Each bucket is built from on-chain Solana token-account balances of labelled addresses; stake-vault balances are moved onto the stakers who own them so they are not counted twice. The gap below the max reflects buybacks/burns shrinking on-chain supply, not bridges (ZBCN is Solana-only here). Holdings includes the team-cluster signers and allocation wallet 56veX (~400M from team ops 9Sq2 at 40M a month past the Mar 2026 vesting end; recipient unknown; not Team). Exchange custody includes the Uphold/Fireblocks cluster (8gQjn, J8FN, 82P4, 6XHz) and Poloniex Squad Vault SOL-P (Eueeb). Uphold caveat, same as Hot Wallet 3/5: ~545M of buybacks (504.7M as of Jul 2026 plus 40.54M in the Q3 post) may sit inside omnibus Uphold/Fireblocks wallets and cannot be split out, so those balances stay cex. Open a bucket for the addresses and sources.
supplyBreakdown.verify: Open each labelled wallet on Solscan. Vesting end is in the Zebec tokenomics blog and docs (and the Oct 2026 MiCA white paper). Uphold's Canada risk statement describes Fireblocks cold storage; the buyback blog describes Uphold Institutional custody. A Figment/Uphold webinar says assets never leave Fireblocks custody. EkXEg still holds ~108.26M after sending ~437M to team ops 9Sq2.
